sources_opened.pages: printed pp.112-115 (PDF pages 120-123): Section 3.1, (3.1.1)-(3.1.2), Lemma 3.1.1, Theorems 3.1.2-3.1.3, Exercises 3.1.1-3.1.4

components.note: Definitions of factorial, binomial coefficient (zero outside range), ~, fair signs, lattice L_N, Bernoulli count B_N, phi/Phi with normalization from the on-route Gaussian integral (thm:p15-normal-normalization), ceiling/floor and the empty-supremum convention are all stated; no proof owed.

All four assertions (log remainder, odd log series with justified interchange, Durrett Lemma 3.1.1 scalar limit, Exercise 3.1.1 triangular product) stated and proved in written steps; matches Durrett pp.114-115 and Feller (8.11) p.51.

Binomial mass/mean/variance, Feller VI.(3.4)-(3.6) upper and lower tail bounds (pp.150-151) and Feller VII Lemma 2 (1.7)-(1.8) Gaussian tail bounds (pp.175, 179) stated and fully proved, including the r=N edge and the derivative identities (1.9).

Feller II.9 (9.2)-(9.15) Robbins argument with both bounds proved (pp.52-54); constant determined by the Feller VII.2 footnote-3 tail argument (p.180) written in full; independent second determination via on-route thm:p15-weak-elementary-asymptotics; footnote-17 refinement proved with explicit bound 6/(5n^5).

Durrett Theorem 3.1.2 and factorization (3.1.2) (pp.113-114) with exact remainder formula, explicit uniform bound K_A/n, moving-k limit, both-parity lattice version, wrong-parity and extreme-point cases all proved in steps.

Durrett Theorem 3.1.3 (p.115) for all m, exact finite index formula, Riemann-sum step with uniform error, source odd step S_{2n+1}=S_{2n}+-1, strict/singleton/infinite endpoint variants and the CDF limit all proved.
Poisson law for lambda>0 and lambda=0, i.i.d. Poisson(1) sequence and T_n separated from S_N are defined; no proof owed.
Normalization (exponential series proved from Taylor remainder), mean and variance, exact law of T_n via the multinomial count (Durrett Ex. 3.1.2 premise, p.115) all proved.

Durrett Exercise 3.1.2 local limit (p.115) proved with explicit uniform remainder; the interval consequence the source leaves unproved is proved, with exact thresholds and strict/singleton/infinite endpoint variants.
gamma(a) on [-1,1] with 0log0=0 (Durrett Ex. 3.1.3, p.115), I(a) for a>0 and the log0=-infinity convention defined; no proof owed.

Durrett Exercise 3.1.3 (p.115) proved by the source-indicated point-mass and successive-ratio route with explicit geometric comparison and rounding k_n=ceil(na); endpoint rates for a<=0, a=1, a>1 proved.
Durrett Exercise 3.1.4 (p.115) limit a-1-a log a proved with both comparison inequalities; the a=1, 0<a<1 and a<=0 cases proved separately.

Fixed-p uniform local limit with explicit Taylor and factorial remainders, interval sums with exact indices, convergence in distribution via CDFs and Chebyshev cutoffs, p in {0,1} degeneracy and the non-claim for p=p_N all present; labelled as an extension of Durrett.

Relative vs absolute error (Feller p.52 distinction), A_5 and the Robbins upper value, two rate values, dependence counterexample, failure of uniform relative approximation at the extreme point, and the p_N=1/N failure (via on-route thm:p15-weak-portmanteau) all proved.

Proof-boundary entry stating the completed Durrett 3.1 route (Lemma 3.1.1, Thms 3.1.2-3.1.3, Exercises 3.1.1-3.1.4) and the Feller II.9/VII.2 constant; each named item is present at the entries above; continuation to characteristic functions/CLT named; no proof owed.
